entries.en: The mock tribunal heard a fictional claim of constructive dismissal.
entries.zh: 模拟法庭审理了一宗虚构的推定解雇申诉。

entries.en: The survey asked when each household had last replaced a consumer durable.
entries.zh: 调查询问了每个家庭最近一次更换耐用消费品的时间。

entries.en: Our course uses continuous assessment rather than relying on one final examination.
entries.zh: 我们的课程采用连续评估，而不是只依赖一次期末考试。

entries.en: The convector heater stood against the far wall of the waiting room.
entries.zh: 那台对流加热器靠着等候室远处的墙放着。

entries.en: Her memoir recalls the music lessons she attended at a convent school.
entries.zh: 她的回忆录讲述了自己在女修道会学校上音乐课的往事。

entries.en: The fictional contract included a cooling-off period before the purchase became final.
entries.zh: 那份虚构合同规定，在购买最终确定之前有一段冷静期。

entries.en: Calling the problem unavoidable seemed like a cop-out to the volunteers.
entries.zh: 在志愿者们看来，把问题说成不可避免，像是在推卸责任。

entries.meaningZh: 住宅区附近的小商店〔英式英语〕
entries.en: The corner shop kept a parcel for me until I returned from work.
entries.zh: 住宅区附近的小商店替我保管了一个包裹，直到我下班回来。

entries.meaningZh: 谋求控制公司的收购者
entries.en: The novel's corporate raider mistakes the small firm's loyalty for weakness.
entries.zh: 小说中，那位谋求收购控制权的人把小公司的忠诚误当成了软弱。

entries.en: The accounting class compared corporation tax with personal income tax.
entries.zh: 会计课比较了公司税与个人所得税。

entries.en: The damaged display items were sold at cost price.
entries.zh: 那些受损的展示品以成本价出售。

entries.en: We questioned the cost-effectiveness of printing a booklet for every visitor.
entries.zh: 我们质疑，给每位访客印一本小册子是否合乎成本效益。

entries.en: She borrowed costume jewellery to complete the stage outfit.
entries.zh: 她借来一些人造珠宝饰物，与舞台服装搭配。

entries.en: The baker set a cottage loaf beside the smaller rolls.
entries.zh: 面包师把一个大小两圆叠成的面包放在了小圆面包旁。

entries.meaningZh: 公厕中的男同性性活动〔英式俚语〕
entries.en: The historian discussed cottaging without naming the men in the records.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家讨论了公厕中的男同性性活动，但没有披露档案中那些男子的姓名。

entries.en: She asked the pharmacist to explain the label on the bottle of cough medicine.
entries.zh: 她请药剂师解释那瓶止咳药上的标签。

entries.en: The bottle of cough mixture was still sealed inside its cardboard box.
entries.zh: 那瓶止咳药水仍密封在纸盒里。

entries.meaningZh: 地方当局兴建的住宅〔英国〕
entries.en: They planted a small garden behind their council house.
entries.zh: 他们在自己住的地方公屋后面种了一小片花园。

entries.en: In the novel, the council of war continues long after midnight.
entries.zh: 小说中，那场军事会议一直开到午夜过后很久。

entries.en: Her strongest counter-argument appeared near the end of the essay.
entries.zh: 她最有力的反驳出现在文章接近结尾的地方。

entries.en: The team prepared a counter-attack as soon as it regained possession.
entries.zh: 那支队伍一重新控球，就准备发动反击。

entries.en: The exhibition explores the music and clothing of a local counter-culture.
entries.zh: 这场展览探讨了当地一种反主流文化的音乐与服饰。

entries.en: The thriller follows a translator drawn into counter-espionage against her wishes.
entries.zh: 这部惊悚小说讲述了一名翻译不情愿地卷入反间谍活动的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 反情报行动；反间谍活动
entries.en: His fictional role in counter-intelligence kept him away from the battlefield.
entries.zh: 在故事中，他从事反间谍工作的角色让他远离了战场。

entries.en: The committee rejected the proposed counter-measure as too expensive.
entries.zh: 委员会以成本过高为由，否决了所提议的对策。

entries.en: The novel presents conflicting accounts of the attempted counter-revolution.
entries.zh: 这部小说对那次未遂反革命活动给出了相互矛盾的叙述。

entries.meaningZh: 不习惯城市生活的乡下来客〔可能含轻蔑〕
entries.en: The comedy refuses to treat its country cousin as a figure of ridicule.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧没有把那个不习惯城市生活的乡下来客当成嘲笑对象。

entries.en: The family opened its country seat to visitors for one summer weekend.
entries.zh: 这家人在夏天的一个周末向访客开放了乡间别墅。

entries.en: The novel's final chapter takes place outside the county court.
entries.zh: 小说的最后一章发生在郡法院外面。

entries.en: The students observed a fictional hearing in a court of appeal.
entries.zh: 学生们旁听了一场虚构的上诉法庭审理。

entries.en: The witness waited outside the court of inquiry with her notes.
entries.zh: 证人拿着笔记，在调查法庭外等候。

entries.meaningZh: 无带女式便鞋〔英式英语〕
entries.en: One black court shoe had slipped beneath the dressing table.
entries.zh: 一只黑色无带女式便鞋滑到了梳妆台下面。

entries.en: A fresh cowpat blocked the narrowest part of the footpath.
entries.zh: 一块新鲜牛粪挡在了小路最窄的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 愉快的交谈；欢乐时光〔爱尔兰用语〕
entries.en: We stayed for the craic long after the music had stopped.
entries.zh: 音乐早已停下，我们却为了继续愉快地聊天而留了很久。

entries.en: The memoir criticises the cramming that replaced thoughtful classroom discussion.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录批评了那种取代深入课堂讨论的填鸭式教学。

entries.en: A cranefly circled the lampshade while I tried to read.
entries.zh: 我想看书时，一只大蚊绕着灯罩飞来飞去。

entries.en: Weeds had appeared between the stones of the old crazy paving.
entries.zh: 那片旧碎石铺面上，石块之间已经长出了杂草。

entries.en: He spread cheese on a cream cracker while waiting for the kettle.
entries.zh: 他一边等水烧开，一边在一片奶油苏打饼干上抹奶酪。

entries.en: The fictional debate pairs a creationist with a critic of her views.
entries.zh: 那场虚构辩论把一位特创论者与一位反对其观点的人安排在一起。

entries.en: The investigator suspected creative accounting when the figures changed without explanation.
entries.zh: 数字在没有解释的情况下发生变化后，调查人员怀疑存在粉饰账目的行为。

entries.en: The unexplained delay widened the credibility gap between the board and its employees.
entries.zh: 那次未作解释的拖延扩大了董事会与员工之间的信任差距。

entries.en: The retailer issued a credit note instead of refunding the purchase.
entries.zh: 零售商开了一张贷记单，而不是退还货款。

entries.en: The clerk attached the credit slip to the matching account record.
entries.zh: 办事员把贷方传票附在了相应的账户记录上。

entries.en: The sample statement showed a credit transfer between the two fictional accounts.
entries.zh: 那份样本对账单显示了两个虚构账户之间的一笔贷记转账。

entries.en: The reporter waited beyond the tape surrounding the crime scene.
entries.zh: 记者在围住犯罪现场的警戒线外等候。

entries.en: She wore a crop top beneath the loose jacket during rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时，她在宽松夹克里面穿了一件露腹短上衣。

entries.en: The shelter described the dog as a lively cross-breed.
entries.zh: 收容所把那条狗描述为一只活泼的杂交犬。

entries.en: A cross-current of doubt ran through her otherwise confident speech.
entries.zh: 她原本自信的发言中，却流露出一股怀疑的相反倾向。

entries.en: The rival departments worked at cross-purposes throughout the summer.
entries.zh: 整个夏天，两个相互竞争的部门都在朝着彼此冲突的目标做事。

entries.meaningZh: 取悦观众的表演或人物
entries.en: The final song proved an unexpected crowd-pleaser at the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会上，最后一首歌出乎意料地大受观众欢迎。

entries.meaningZh: 吸引大量观众的表演者或事件
entries.en: The visiting acrobat became the festival's biggest crowd-puller.
entries.zh: 那位来访的杂技演员成了节庆活动中最能吸引观众的人。

entries.en: A cub reporter nervously asked the first question at the press conference.
entries.zh: 一名初出茅庐的记者紧张地提出了新闻发布会上的第一个问题。

entries.en: His office was a cubby-hole tucked behind the main reception desk.
entries.zh: 他的办公室是藏在主接待台后面的一间小屋。

entries.en: Careful culling reduced the pile to a dozen usable photographs.
entries.zh: 经过仔细筛选，那堆照片只剩下十二张可用的。

entries.en: The jeweller selected a cultured pearl for the silver pendant.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠为那枚银吊坠选了一颗养殖珍珠。

entries.en: They discussed current affairs over lunch without turning on the television.
entries.zh: 他们午餐时讨论时事，没有打开电视。

entries.en: A short puppet show served as a curtain-raiser for the evening's main performance.
entries.zh: 一出简短的木偶戏为当晚的主场演出作了开场。

entries.en: The shop expanded its customer base by opening on Sunday mornings.
entries.zh: 那家店通过在周日上午营业，扩大了客户群。

entries.en: Good customer service mattered more to her than a slightly lower price.
entries.zh: 对她来说，良好的客户服务比略低的价格更重要。

entries.en: Each child carried a paper cut-out of a different animal.
entries.zh: 每个孩子都拿着一个不同动物的剪纸图案。

entries.en: The case study describes a dispute between a shop and a cybersquatter.
entries.zh: 这个案例描写了一家商店与一个域名抢注者之间的纠纷。

entries.en: The workshop discussed cybersquatting without examining any current legal case.
entries.zh: 工作坊讨论了域名抢注，没有研究任何正在审理的法律案件。

entries.en: My neighbour is a dab hand at repairing old bicycles.
entries.zh: 我的邻居是修理旧自行车的能手。

entries.en: The photographs show small details of daily life in the village.
entries.zh: 这些照片展示了村里日常生活的一些小细节。

entries.en: After the announcement leaked, the meeting became an exercise in damage limitation.
entries.zh: 公告内容泄露后，那场会议就变成了一次控制损失的行动。

entries.en: She did her damnedest to keep the outdoor concert running.
entries.zh: 她拼尽全力，想让露天音乐会继续进行。

entries.en: The form asked for a date of birth but no other personal details.
entries.zh: 表格要求填写出生日期，但不要求提供其他个人信息。

entries.en: The dawn chorus woke us before the first bus passed.
entries.zh: 第一班公交车经过之前，清晨的鸟鸣声就把我们叫醒了。

entries.en: He rehearses with the band after finishing his day job.
entries.zh: 他结束白天的工作后，再与乐队一起排练。

entries.en: From day one, the volunteers helped decide how the project would run.
entries.zh: 从第一天开始，志愿者们就参与决定项目如何运作。

entries.en: She attended college on day release while keeping her job at the factory.
entries.zh: 她保留了工厂的工作，同时按日脱产去学院学习。

entries.en: Several residents gathered in the day room to play cards.
entries.zh: 几位住户聚在日间活动室里打牌。

entries.en: The fictional day trader records every decision in a notebook.
entries.zh: 故事中的当日交易者把每一个决定都记在笔记本里。

entries.en: We planned a day trip to the coast instead of booking a hotel.
entries.zh: 我们计划到海边来个当日往返短途游，而不是预订酒店。

entries.en: A day-tripper asked which bus returned to the station before evening.
entries.zh: 一位当日往返的游客询问，哪班公交车能在傍晚前回到车站。

entries.en: The old diary records the family's confusion about daylight saving time.
entries.zh: 那本旧日记记下了这家人对夏令时的困惑。

entries.en: The landlord in the novel mistakes his reliable tenant for a dead beat.
entries.zh: 小说中的房东把一位可靠的房客误当成了赖账的人。

entries.meaningZh: 要倒霉的人；死定了〔非正式〕
entries.en: If the coach finds the broken trophy, we are dead meat.
entries.zh: 如果教练发现了那个摔坏的奖杯，我们就死定了。

entries.en: The gardener stacked the dead wood beside the compost heap.
entries.zh: 园丁把枯木堆在了堆肥堆旁。

entries.meaningZh: 促成商业或政治交易的人
entries.en: The company hired a deal-maker who preferred quiet meetings to public announcements.
entries.zh: 那家公司聘请了一位更喜欢私下开会、不爱公开宣布消息的交易撮合者。

entries.en: The loss of the rehearsal space dealt a death blow to the project.
entries.zh: 失去排练场地，给那个项目带来了致命打击。

entries.en: The historical novel describes a family selling land to meet death duties.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说描写了一家人为支付遗产税而出售土地。

entries.en: The actor's death rattle disturbed the audience even though the scene was fictional.
entries.zh: 尽管场景是虚构的，演员发出的临终喉鸣仍让观众感到不安。

entries.en: The fictional lawyer challenges the death sentence in the final scene.
entries.zh: 在最后一幕中，那位虚构律师对死刑判决提出了异议。

entries.en: The novel follows a wealthy family through the death throes of its business.
entries.zh: 这部小说描写了一个富裕家庭在家族企业垂死挣扎期间的经历。

entries.en: The character refuses to enter the abandoned mine, calling it a death trap.
entries.zh: 那个角色拒绝进入废弃矿井，称那里是死亡陷阱。

entries.en: One deck shoe was still wet from the morning walk along the pier.
entries.zh: 早晨沿码头走过一趟后，有一只平底休闲鞋还湿着。

entries.en: We finished the decorating just before the first birthday guests arrived.
entries.zh: 第一批生日客人到来前，我们刚好完成了装饰布置。

entries.en: The staff asked whether delayering would change who approved their work.
entries.zh: 员工们问，压缩管理层次会不会改变由谁审批他们的工作。

entries.en: The lecture examined demutualisation through a fictional insurance company.
entries.zh: 这堂课用一家虚构保险公司作例子，分析了会员制转为股份制的过程。

entries.en: The inquiry examined an allegation of dereliction of duty without assuming guilt.
entries.zh: 调查审查了一项玩忽职守指控，没有预先认定有罪。

entries.en: The novelist sketches a desert island before deciding where the characters will land.
entries.zh: 小说家先画了一座荒岛，再决定让人物在哪里登陆。

entries.en: The seminar examined the ethical questions raised by the idea of a designer baby.
entries.zh: 研讨课分析了定制婴儿这一设想引发的伦理问题。

entries.en: The case study follows an application to a development bank.
entries.zh: 这个案例围绕一项向开发银行提出的申请展开。

entries.en: I lifted the receiver but could not hear a dial tone.
entries.zh: 我拿起话筒，却听不到拨号音。

entries.en: The printed invitation included the dialling code beside the telephone number.
entries.zh: 印好的邀请函在电话号码旁边注明了区号。

entries.en: A steady dialling tone replaced the crackling we had heard earlier.
entries.zh: 先前听到的噼啪杂音消失了，取而代之的是稳定的拨号音。

entries.en: The archivist found the interview on an unlabelled digital audio tape.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在一盘没有标签的数字录音带上找到了那次访谈。

entries.en: The technicians compared digital radio with the older communication system.
entries.zh: 技术人员比较了数字无线电通信与旧通信系统。

entries.en: A damaged file interrupted the digital recording of the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 一个损坏的文件打断了那次排练的数字录制。

entries.en: The museum's display traces the household's gradual switch to digital television.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展品展示了那个家庭逐渐改用数字电视的过程。

entries.en: The mock trial discussed diminished responsibility without applying any real jurisdiction's rules.
entries.zh: 模拟审判讨论了责任减轻的问题，没有适用任何真实司法辖区的规则。

entries.en: After several revisions, we noticed diminishing returns from polishing the same paragraph.
entries.zh: 修改了几次之后，我们发现，继续打磨同一段文字的收益正在递减。

entries.en: They borrowed formal clothes for the charity dinner dance.
entries.zh: 他们借了正式礼服，去参加那场餐后有舞会的慈善宴会。

entries.en: The novel's courier notices a torn strap on the diplomatic bag.
entries.zh: 小说中的信使注意到外交邮袋上的一条带子有破损。

entries.en: Her fictional bank statement listed a direct debit for the monthly membership fee.
entries.zh: 她那份虚构银行对账单列出了一笔用于支付月度会费的直接借记。

entries.en: The exercise asks students to turn direct speech into reported speech.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求学生把直接引语改为间接引语。

entries.en: The economics class compared direct taxation with taxes on purchases.
entries.zh: 经济学课比较了直接征税与对购买行为征税。

entries.en: The director general postponed her speech until the interpreter arrived.
entries.zh: 那位女局长把讲话推迟到了译员到来之后。

entries.en: He called directory enquiries because the number was missing from the letter.
entries.zh: 信中没有电话号码，所以他打给了号码查询台。

entries.en: My noisy phone earned me a dirty look from the passenger opposite.
entries.zh: 我那吵闹的手机招来了对面乘客不满的一瞥。

entries.meaningZh: 与情人共度的周末〔非正式〕
entries.en: The comedy turns their planned dirty weekend into a series of misunderstandings.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧把他们原计划与情人共度的周末，变成了一连串的误会。

entries.en: The district nurse left a message asking which entrance she should use.
entries.zh: 那位社区巡回护士留了言，询问自己应该从哪个入口进去。

entries.en: The child mistook the faded division sign for a minus sign.
entries.zh: 那个孩子把模糊的除号误认成了减号。

entries.en: The memoir describes years of doctoring in an isolated mountain village.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录描写了在偏僻山村行医多年的经历。

entries.en: The docusoap follows the same hospital staff through several busy weeks.
entries.zh: 这部纪实性肥皂剧跟拍同一批医院员工，记录了他们忙碌的几个星期。

entries.en: The dog's name was stitched inside the faded dog-collar.
entries.zh: 那只狗的名字绣在褪色的狗项圈内侧。

entries.en: She did the donkey work of sorting receipts while we checked the totals.
entries.zh: 她负责整理收据这种单调费力的工作，我们则核对总额。

entries.en: He got into a doodah when he could not find the tickets.
entries.zh: 找不到票时，他慌成了一团。

entries.en: The novel's traveller spends his last coins on a bed in a doss-house.
entries.zh: 小说中的旅人用最后几枚硬币，在廉价客栈里找了个床位。

entries.en: The sisters' double act mixed juggling with comic arguments.
entries.zh: 姐妹俩的双人表演把杂耍与滑稽的争吵穿插在一起。

entries.en: Rain delayed the start of the afternoon's double bill.
entries.zh: 雨延误了当天下午连续两场比赛的开赛时间。

entries.en: In the puzzle, her apparent confession is a double bluff.
entries.zh: 在那道谜题里，她看似认罪的举动其实是虚实相间的骗局。

entries.en: The novel gradually reveals the quiet neighbour's double life.
entries.zh: 这部小说逐渐揭示了那位安静邻居的双重生活。

entries.en: Public attention proved a double-edged sword for the young artist.
entries.zh: 对那位年轻艺术家来说，公众关注成了一把双刃剑。

entries.en: The landlord postponed the double-glazing until the scaffolding was ready.
entries.zh: 房东把安装双层玻璃的工作推迟到了脚手架准备好之后。

entries.meaningZh: 惊讶后的再次确认；迟一拍的反应
entries.en: I did a double-take when I recognised my teacher on the stage.
entries.zh: 认出台上是我的老师时，我愣了一下，又仔细看了看。

entries.en: The residents demanded a clear answer instead of more double-talk.
entries.zh: 居民们要求一个明确答案，不要再听含糊其词的搪塞。

entries.en: The downshifter exchanged a long commute for a small workshop near home.
entries.zh: 那个放慢生活节奏的人不再长途通勤，转而在家附近的小作坊工作。

entries.en: The chart shows a downtrend in attendance after the venue changed.
entries.zh: 图表显示，更换场地后，出席人数呈下降趋势。

entries.meaningZh: 大惊小怪的人〔非正式，贬称〕
entries.en: She resented being called a drama queen for raising a genuine concern.
entries.zh: 她只是提出了真正的担忧，却被叫作大惊小怪的人，因此很不满。

entries.en: The coach's dream team included experienced players and two promising newcomers.
entries.zh: 教练心目中的最佳阵容既有经验丰富的球员，也有两位有前途的新人。

entries.en: The fictional party presented the two candidates as a dream ticket.
entries.zh: 故事中的政党把那两名候选人包装成了黄金搭档。

entries.en: He received a dressing-down after arriving late for the third rehearsal.
entries.zh: 他在第三场排练时迟到了，之后挨了一顿严厉训斥。

entries.en: Donations arrived in dribs and drabs throughout the winter.
entries.zh: 整个冬天，捐款都是零零星星地到来。

entries.en: Winning the contract put the small company in the driver's seat.
entries.zh: 赢得合同，让那家小公司占据了控制地位。

entries.en: A late drop goal gave the fictional team a narrow lead.
entries.zh: 临近结束时的一次落地球射门得分，让故事中的球队取得了微弱领先。

entries.en: Choose a language from the dropdown before starting the exercise.
entries.zh: 开始练习前，请先从下拉列表中选择一种语言。

entries.en: We moved the drum kit away from the leaking roof.
entries.zh: 我们把架子鼓从漏水的屋顶下面移开了。

entries.en: The novel opens with a witness reporting a drunk driver.
entries.zh: 这部小说以一名证人举报酒后驾驶者开篇。

entries.en: The school invited a speaker to discuss the consequences of drunk driving.
entries.zh: 学校邀请了一位演讲者，讨论酒后驾车的后果。

entries.en: The old shop sold dry goods behind a row of dusty windows.
entries.zh: 那家老店在一排蒙尘的橱窗后出售纺织品。

entries.en: The kitchen staff waited for the dumb waiter to return with empty trays.
entries.zh: 厨房员工等着小型升降送货机把空托盘送回来。

entries.en: A dumper truck waited beside the unfinished road.
entries.zh: 一辆翻斗车在尚未完工的道路旁等候。

entries.en: A minor disagreement over seats turned into a noisy dust-up.
entries.zh: 一场因座位产生的小分歧，演变成了吵闹的争执。

entries.en: We spread a dustsheet over the sofa before painting the ceiling.
entries.zh: 粉刷天花板前，我们在沙发上铺了一块防尘布。

entries.en: She bought a notebook at the duty-free shop before boarding.
entries.zh: 登机前，她在免税商店买了一本笔记本。

entries.en: The e-book kept my place even after I closed the app.
entries.zh: 即使关闭应用后，那本电子书仍保留着我的阅读位置。

entries.en: The evening course introduced e-business through a fictional craft shop.
entries.zh: 那门夜校课程用一家虚构的手工艺品商店作例子，介绍电子商务。

entries.en: The college combined e-learning with weekly meetings in a classroom.
entries.zh: 学院把网络学习与每周的线下课堂结合起来。

entries.en: The students launched an e-zine featuring photographs from their field trips.
entries.zh: 学生们创办了一份电子杂志，刊载野外考察时拍摄的照片。

entries.en: Her eagle eye spotted the missing decimal point before we printed the report.
entries.zh: 她目光敏锐，在报告印刷前发现了漏掉的小数点。

entries.en: The cafe played easy listening while the lunch crowd thinned.
entries.zh: 午餐客流逐渐减少时，咖啡馆里播放着舒缓的音乐。

entries.en: The novel builds suspense around a conversation overheard through eavesdropping.
entries.zh: 这部小说围绕一段通过偷听获悉的对话营造悬念。

entries.en: The village debated whether eco-tourism would change its quiet character.
entries.zh: 村里人讨论，生态旅游会不会改变村庄安静的风貌。

entries.en: An educational psychologist observed the lesson with the teacher's permission.
entries.zh: 经教师同意，一位教育心理学家旁听观察了那节课。

entries.en: She chose educational psychology after volunteering in an after-school programme.
entries.zh: 在课后活动项目中做过志愿者后，她选择了教育心理学。

entries.en: The archivist compared two old versions of the electoral register.
entries.zh: 档案管理员比较了两个旧版的选民登记册。

entries.en: Her paternal grandfather's name appeared on the faded electoral roll.
entries.zh: 她祖父的名字出现在那份褪色的选民名册上。

entries.en: The small press explored electronic publishing before changing its production process.
entries.zh: 那家小出版社在改变制作流程前，先研究了电子出版。

entries.en: The documentary questions how electronic tagging affects the people being monitored.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了电子标记追踪如何影响被监控的人。

entries.en: We stopped for elevenses beneath the orchard's largest tree.
entries.zh: 我们在果园里最大的树下停下来，吃了午前茶点。

entries.en: The residents kept the entrance clear for the emergency services.
entries.zh: 居民们让入口保持畅通，方便紧急救援部门进入。

entries.en: The training course discussed emotional intelligence without treating it as a fixed score.
entries.zh: 培训课程讨论了情绪智力，没有把它当成一个固定的分数。

entries.en: The staff asked how the new recruitment plan would support equal opportunities.
entries.zh: 员工们问，新的招聘计划将如何支持机会均等。

entries.en: The waiter brought a crisp escalope with a wedge of lemon.
entries.zh: 服务员端来一片炸得酥脆的肉片，配着一角柠檬。

entries.en: The escape artist paused to acknowledge the audience before beginning the final trick.
entries.zh: 脱身术表演者在开始最后一个节目之前，先停下来向观众致意。

entries.en: The comedy retells an eternal triangle from each character's point of view.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧从每个角色的视角，重新讲述了一段三角恋。

entries.en: She joined an evening class to learn how to repair furniture.
entries.zh: 她参加了一个夜间课程，学习如何修理家具。

entries.en: The fairy tale gives its evil-doer a chance to change.
entries.zh: 那个童话给了作恶者一次改过的机会。

entries.en: The lecturer questioned whether his field could be called an exact science.
entries.zh: 讲师提出疑问：自己的领域是否称得上精密科学。

entries.en: We repacked the cases after discovering how much excess baggage we had.
entries.zh: 发现超重行李有多少之后，我们重新整理了行李箱。

entries.en: The photographer stopped at the marked edge of the exclusion zone.
entries.zh: 摄影师在标明的禁区边界处停了下来。

entries.en: A pressed leaf fell from the child's exercise book.
entries.zh: 一片压平保存的叶子从孩子的练习本里掉了出来。

entries.en: The historical novel's protagonist waits anxiously for an exit visa.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说的主人公焦急地等待着出境签证。

entries.en: The novel follows a cook travelling with an expeditionary force.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一名随远征军出行的厨师的经历。

entries.en: She removed the silver eye shadow after the last performance.
entries.zh: 最后一场演出结束后，她卸掉了银色眼影。

entries.en: He mentioned his eye strain when discussing the cramped workspace.
entries.zh: 讨论狭窄的工作区时，他提到了自己的眼疲劳问题。

entries.en: Visiting the tiny backstage area was an eye-opener for the students.
entries.zh: 参观那片狭小的后台区域，让学生们大开眼界。

entries.en: The compromise offered the committee a face-saver without concealing the mistake.
entries.zh: 那个折中方案让委员会保全了面子，又没有掩盖错误。

entries.en: A clean facecloth lay folded beside the bedroom washbasin.
entries.zh: 一条干净的洗脸毛巾叠放在卧室洗脸盆旁。

entries.en: Long winter evenings were a fact of life in the remote village.
entries.zh: 漫长的冬夜是那个偏远村庄生活中无法改变的事实。

entries.en: The organiser handed each visitor a fact sheet about the exhibition.
entries.zh: 组织者给每位访客发了一张有关展览的情况说明书。

entries.en: The seminar compared different accounts of factory farming in the countryside.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了对乡村工厂化农场经营的不同叙述。

entries.en: The manager spent the morning on the factory floor listening to the workers.
entries.zh: 经理整个上午都在工厂车间听工人们说话。
